body:
EXACT-SHA HOLD on clean 99fd15eef1d9ccc7d2d83d8aaa2c0e5fe6d70aa5.

This is 8d9bd11 rebased onto current main 1ebdad3. Parent is correct. `provider-parser` tree is identical (`2e8e822`). The three identity doors are unchanged:

1. `ModelInputObserved(value, checksum)` still stores raw joined token text. Receipt render binds only checksum. Production sets `checksum = Checksum.ofText(value)` but the public enum allows a forged pair, and the decision object retains story text.
2. `AlignmentSidecarAccepted` still exposes `providerNodeIds` plus an independently supplied checksum. Production `sidecarChecksum` includes node ids; receipt render/digest bind only dialect+checksum. Two node-id vectors with the same supplied checksum are the same receipt.
3. `ParserSetupFailure` still exposes `ArtifactMissing(Vector.empty)`, `PlatformIncompatible(current, Vector(current))`, `ResourceBudgetInsufficient(required <= available)`, and blank `Custom` platform/resource labels.

I am not treating the 53/53 run on the same tree as a freeze. Successor must derive/hide observation and sidecar values, smart-construct the Unavailable facts, then I will run A/B/C/D and swapped-ordinal on that exact clean commit.

Scout path proposal: read, not reserving, not editing. Names are the chief's. Coverage review starts after this contract freezes.
